newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes stronger near 2,200 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes stronger near 2,200 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 2,180-2,220 per dollar, stronger from the morning's 2,450-2,500 as dollar supply strongly outweighed demand on the interbank market, dealers said.
"(Foreign currency) buyers were heavily outnumbered by sellers and the lev gained some 300 on the day," a dealer said.
It was natural for the market to seek stronger lev levels today after the lev failed to break through the 2,500 per dollar level on Friday despite increased dollar demand, dealers said.
The lev fell to 2,400-2,500 per dollar at the close on Friday from the opening's 2,100 due to higher dollar demand.

"Market makers might test levels near 2,000 tomorrow amid the current low dollar demand from large clients but even if demand rises I expect trade to consolidate between 2,000-2,500," another dealer said. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
